0022600189.text: The Denver Nuggets (4-3, on a one-game win streak and 2 games back of the 4th-place Northwest standings) are the designated road team against the Indiana Pacers (3-6, on a one-game win streak and 3.5 games back in the 3rd-place Central) in this NBA Mexico City Game at a neutral site in Mexico City. Denver is without Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (hamstring), both out, and DeRozan is day-to-day with back spasms and a game-time decision. Indiana is missing Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain), and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), while Kelly Oubre Jr. is day-to-day with a calf bruise and a game-time decision. The Nuggets won both meetings in the 2025-26 season, including a 135-120 win in Indianapolis on December 3, 2025, and the 2026-27 season series has no games yet.
